business_problem: Old Mutual operated more than 100 regulated companies across 12 countries with different general ledger systems, internal processes, and standards, leaving leadership without a seamless end-to-end financial view or a single source of truth.
solution_summary: Old Mutual used Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance as a common finance platform across more than 100 regulated companies operating in 12 African countries. The program replaced varied general ledgers, local standards, and manual comparisons with a single chart of accounts, embedded controls, and automated workflows, giving the group a single source of truth for financial and performance data. Instead of reconciling disconnected systems, finance teams now load transactions, standardize processes, and monitor results inside the same cloud ERP. Leadership consumes near real-time reporting from that platform, while the standardized controls improve consistency, compliance, fraud prevention, and transparency across the organization’s operating entities.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Finance
solution_components.role: Serves as the unified financial management platform that standardizes processes, controls, and reporting across Old Mutual’s businesses.

data_flow: Financial and performance data from operating companies flows into Dynamics 365 Finance, where a common chart of accounts and automated workflows standardize processing before near real-time reports are surfaced to leadership and finance teams.
business_outcome: Old Mutual gained near real-time financial reporting, stronger internal controls, and major efficiency gains, including cutting bank-transaction upload and reconciliation work from up to five days to half a day.
metrics: Implementation completed in under four years
Uploading and reconciling bank transactions dropped from up to five days to half a day
Finance teams gained four and a half days to focus on surfacing insights
architecture_clues: Single design for the chart of accounts across regulated entities
Embedded internal controls in Dynamics 365 Finance
Automated end-to-end financial processes and reporting
evidence_quotes: With more than 100 companies across 12 countries, Old Mutual required a unified platform to provide real-time visibility and insights across the organization.
It became clear that we needed a single source of truth. Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance provided a powerful, flexible, and configurable platform to meet this need.
Tasks such as uploading and reconciling bank transactions, which once took up to five days, are now completed in just half a day thanks to automation and integration features.
